subsystem.name: GenericRuntimeObjects
subsystem.responsibility: Low-level runtime support objects shared across modules: streambuf-style buffer-control objects, refcounted string buffers, ostream/istream construction scaffolding, file-handle close guards, a process-wide critical-section facility with a one-time-init state machine, a global object registration table, callback lists, MSVC scalar-deleting-destructor and RTTI/exception scaffolding, surface allocation containers, and bitmap-tracked unit allocation.

summary: Proposal reconstructs twenty-seven generic runtime-object routines into eighteen defensible classes plus shared stream/critical-section interfaces. Core clusters: (1) a streambuf-style buffer-control object (0x005994BC ctor, 0x0059A473 initializer, 0x0059A4C9 ring init) with a self-referential ring of stream-position pointer slots, a locale-facet refcount path, and an external-buffer install; (2) a refcounted string buffer (0x00599615 write, 0x0059A9CA subrange assign) sharing full-length buffers through a refcount byte before the data pointer; (3) iostream construction (0x00599B1C ostream frame, 0x00599BF0 istream/locale) sharing StreamCreationWithFlagInit; (4) a global critical-section facility (0x0059A54D init+enter, 0x0059A5E9 guarded leave) keyed by the atomic state global 0x008D4610; (5) a global 8-slot object table (0x0059A8FA); and (6) two stream lock/query wrappers (0x0059BBAF, 0x0059BCD2). All packet owners are UNKNOWN; class ownership assignments are DERIVED/GUESS proposals, and equal byte offsets on different classes (e.g. this+0x50 as buffer base in CStreamBufferControl versus file handle in CFileHandleCloseGuard) are kept as distinct fields per rule 8.

classes.name: CStreamBufferControl
classes.responsibility: Streambuf-style buffer-control object with a self-referential ring of stream-position pointer slots, an optional external caller buffer install, a locale-facet refcount path, and a mode flag selecting internal vs external buffer layout.

classes.name: CRefCountedStringBuffer
classes.responsibility: Reference-counted byte-string buffer storing its refcount byte immediately before the data pointer; supports capacity-guaranteed writes with NUL termination and copy-on-assign full-length buffer sharing.

classes.name: CFileHandleCloseGuard
classes.responsibility: Object storing a file handle at +0x50 and closing it through FileCloseWithLock, reporting failure through a status-raising helper called with literal arguments (0, 2) and returning this as a non-null failure signal.

classes.name: COStreamObjectConstructor
classes.responsibility: Constructs a std::basic_ostream-family stream object from frame-passed handle/name and mode fields, registering an SEH handler and installing the basic_ios/basic_ostream vtable chain before opening the stream.

classes.name: CIStreamObjectConstructor
classes.responsibility: Constructs a locale/istream-family object with a multi-inheritance vtable layout (base vtable, basic_ios vtable, and an adjusted basic_istream vtable written at the slot selected by *(*(this)+4)), completing construction through StreamCreationWithFlagInit.

classes.name: CGlobalObjectChain
classes.responsibility: Module-level initializer installing an SEH handler and reference-count-guarding a one-time construction chain of seven linked global objects (vtable/SEH-chain and locale-style objects) in static module storage.

classes.name: CGlobalCriticalSectionFacility
classes.responsibility: Thread-safe one-time initialization and enter/leave of the process-wide critical section, keyed by the atomic state global Target (0=uninitialized, 1=initializing, 2=ready). The state (Target at 0x008D4610) and the CRITICAL_SECTION object (at 0x008D45F8) are globals carried in evidence_refs rather than this-relative fields.

classes.name: CGlobalObjectTableFacility
classes.responsibility: Global 8-slot object registration table (entries at 0x008D4618, ref-count bytes at 0x008D463C) with a parallel ref-count byte array; objects self-register by advancing their slot-index field at this+0x24 until an empty or already-self slot is found. The table arrays are globals carried in evidence_refs; the per-object slot index is a this-relative field.

classes.name: CCallbackListOwner
classes.responsibility: Object owning two singly-linked callback lists (head pointers at +0x18 and +0x1C); teardown runs the registered callback chain then frees both lists through FreeWrapper and clears both heads.

classes.name: CScalarDeletingDestructorThunk
classes.responsibility: MSVC scalar-deleting-destructor thunk pattern: invoke the destructor body then free the object storage through FreeWrapper only when the deletion flag low bit is set; returns the object pointer.

classes.name: CStdLogicErrorException
classes.responsibility: std::logic_error-derived exception objects (std::length_error, std::out_of_range) constructed by building the logic_error base then overwriting the object vtable pointer.

classes.name: CRefCountedConversionGuard
classes.responsibility: Reference-counted guarded wrapper around a delegated conversion routine: bumps an interlocked counter, optionally lazily enters critical section 19, and balances counter or lock on exit.

classes.name: CArgumentPackDispatch
classes.responsibility: Packs a small fixed argument array, validates/reorders it against a version string, dispatches it with mode 4, and writes the parsed output pointer back through the out parameter.

classes.name: CSurfaceAllocationContainer
classes.responsibility: Surface/bitmap container allocating a zeroed pixel buffer, a clip-rectangle entry array (pair of WORDs each), working counters, and dimension fields; dimensions default to 1 when the argument is zero.

classes.name: CUnitBitmapTracker
classes.responsibility: Bitmap-tracked unit allocator: grows a bitmap byte array and a parallel element array, marks a2 consecutive bits used, records the cumulative-counter low word plus size per element, and returns the slot index.

classes.name: CTypeInfoDestructor
classes.responsibility: Destructor for an MSVC RTTI type-info object: restores the canonical type-info vtable, frees the type-descriptor name string under critical section 27, and leaves it.

classes.name: CStreamBufferDescriptor
classes.responsibility: FILE-stream-family buffer descriptor: validates a mode/size contract, rounds the size down to even, selects embedded/caller/heap buffer, manages the flag word, and writes buffer position/count/base/size fields under a critical section.

classes.name: CStreamLockedQuery
classes.responsibility: Critical-section-wrapped stream query/read wrappers: lock the stream handle, run a query/read primitive, unlock, and return the 16-bit result.

transitions.trigger: winning thread atomically claims initialization via InterlockedExchange
losing threads spin with Sleep(1) while Target==1
steady-state enter path; guarded leave requires Target==2

interfaces.name: IStreamCreation
interfaces.purpose: Complete construction of a stream object from a handle/name argument and a mode argument; invoked by both the ostream frame setup and the istream/locale constructor.

interfaces.name: IBufferCapacityEnsure
interfaces.purpose: Ensure a string buffer has capacity for a requested length; called before byte copies in both the write and subrange-assign paths.

interfaces.name: ILazyCriticalSectionGate
interfaces.purpose: Lazily enter and leave a numbered global critical section; used by refcounted-conversion and type-info teardown paths.

compatibility_contracts.name: CriticalSectionReadinessGate
compatibility_contracts.description: Enter/Leave of the global critical section must be gated on the atomic init-state global equalling 2 (ready); state 0 triggers one-time initialization by a single winning thread and state 1 makes other threads spin with Sleep(1).

compatibility_contracts.name: ScalarDeletingDestructorAbi
compatibility_contracts.description: MSVC scalar-deleting-destructor convention: run the destructor body on the object, then free the storage through FreeWrapper only when the deletion flag low bit is set, and return the object pointer.

compatibility_contracts.name: RefCountedStringBufferShareContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Full-length buffer assignment shares the source buffer by adopting its data/length/capacity pointers and incrementing the refcount byte stored immediately before the data pointer; partial or empty copies fall back to an allocation path, and a null source data pointer falls back to a static empty-string sentinel.

compatibility_contracts.name: StreamBufferSetupContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Buffer setup validates the mode/size contract (mode 4 always allowed; otherwise size >= 2 and mode in {0, 64}), rounds the size down to even, runs under the stream critical section, and selects an embedded (effective size 2), caller-supplied, or heap-allocated buffer; returns 0 on success and -1 on validation or allocation failure.

compatibility_contracts.name: GlobalObjectTableRegistrationContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Objects self-register into a global 8-slot table by advancing their slot-index field until an empty or already-self slot is found; the table stores the object pointer and increments the matching ref-count byte.

compatibility_contracts.name: StreamLockQueryDiscipline
compatibility_contracts.description: Stream queries and reads must be wrapped in enter/leave of the stream critical section keyed by the stream handle, preserving the 16-bit result across the unlock call.

unresolved: All packet owner markers are UnknownObject/UNKNOWN; every class assignment here is a DERIVED or GUESS proposal, not a confirmed original type.

The meaning of the literal 2 argument passed to the error-reporting helpers (called with (0, 2)) from the file-close guards is unknown; whether the returned non-null pointer is consumed as an error object or merely as a boolean is unresolved.
The locale facet pointer at +0x4C appears only in raw source and has no field evidence reference; its type and ownership are unknown.
The sentinel comparison this == -76 (0xFFFFFFB4) in the buffer-control constructor is DERIVED, not independently evidenced.

Offset +0x50 carries different semantics on different objects: buffer base in CStreamBufferControl versus file handle in CFileHandleCloseGuard. Per rule 8 these are kept as distinct fields; common ownership is not claimed.
sub_599560 (capacity ensure) semantics and its third argument (growth policy, alignment, or exact-fit flag) are unknown; whether it reallocates and updates this+0x4 is not visible in the packet.
The identities of dword_8D5A60 and dword_8D5A68 (buffer capacity constants) are DERIVED only.
The concrete types and runtime purpose of the globals constructed by GuardedGlobalObjectChainInit are unknown; the +vtable[1] displacement arithmetic is unverified.

The CEHFrameSetup and LocaleObjectAllocAndVtableSetup __userpurge/__ebp ABI means their field offsets map onto a caller stack frame, not a conventional object; the stream-object slot selector *v5+4 and the relationship between the unk_5B9C* vftables are not established.
The identity of the compiler guard/SEH helpers used by the global-chain init and the semantics of the module reference counter beyond first-vs-subsequent are unknown.
The owners of critical-section indices 19 and 27 are unknown; the relation of the CriticalSection/Target globals to the refcount and locale subsystems is not established.
The mode-4 dispatch semantics of sub_5357E0, the version-string meaning, and the format of the parsed output in CArgumentPackDispatch are not established here.
The clip-rectangle entry layout (pair of WORDs) and the width/height reading of surface container fields 0x18/0x1C are inferred, not typed-evidenced.
The type-descriptor name allocation scheme in CTypeInfoDestructor is not proven from this packet alone.
dword_5E9EF4 (the module reference counter read by GuardedGlobalObjectChainInit) is described from packet prose only and has no allowed evidence reference; no role is asserted.
